issue:
REGRESSION: Error during test collection in ecoutils

After the recent changes, there seems to be an issue with the test collection process in the `ecoutils` module. The error occurs when attempting to collect tests, resulting in an interruption of the test session. This was not an issue in previous versions.

To reproduce the issue, ensure you have the latest changes applied and attempt to run the test suite. The error should manifest during the test collection phase, preventing the tests from executing as expected.

This regression needs to be addressed to restore the test suite's functionality.
